incident: ADVERSARIAL, #347. The canary only answers "did I get the whole file" while it is LAST. An edit appended below it leaves the marker readable and everything after it invisible -- a reader sees the canary, concludes its copy is whole, and is wrong. A reasonable person adding a section to the end of CLAUDE.md does exactly this and expects it to pass. Exit 2, not 1: the gate cannot certify what a reader would receive.
stdout_contains: canary is NOT the last line
